questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Macros and derives”?
options: derive avoids hand-writing common trait implementations.
Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
Use rustup to keep toolchain updates and installed versions explicit.
Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
questions.answer: derive avoids hand-writing common trait implementations.
questions.explanation:
derive avoids hand-writing common trait implementations.
Why: Declarative `macro_rules!` expands token patterns into reusable syntax; derive macros generate parts of trait implementations for structs and enums. Because expansion happens at compile time, debugging differs and diagnostics may point to generated code. Prefer functions and generics unless repeated syntax or compile-time inspection justifies a macro.
